title: superheavy-gravDM: code and data for 'Superheavy gravitational dark matter from runaway bubble collisions'
description: Physics package (src/gravdm), compute and figure scripts, stored numerical results, the figures of the main text and of the Supplemental Material, tests, third-party data and a provenance map (docs/PROVENANCE.md) from every figure, table and number of the paper to the script and output that produce it. Code: MIT licence; stored results and figures: CC BY 4.0.
